title: Using Taxol-sensitized budding yeast to investigate the effect of microtubule stabilization on anaphase onset
protocol: Inoculate 5 mL SC media with Taxol-sensitive yeast strain MGY 2150.
Grow the culture at 30°C for 12–24 h before using as a pre-culture to inoculate larger cultures.
Use the freshly saturated 5 mL culture to inoculate into a 30-50 mL culture in SC media at 30°C, at a dilution that will be in log phase with an OD600 of 0.15–0.4 the next morning.
Pellet the cells by centrifugation (3,000 g for 3–5 min) once desired OD is reached.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 10 mL SC media.
Add 3.5 μL alpha-factor (3.5 μM final concentration) to arrest the culture in G1.
Incubate and shake/rotate these cells at 30°C for 3 hours.
Check under a light microscope to ensure >95% unbudded and/or schmooing cells.
Label 10 microfuge tubes per condition for each time point: 0, 60, 90, 120, 150, 165, 180, 195, 210, and 240 minutes.
Take approximately 100 μL of the culture and spin down in a 1.5 mL microfuge tube.
Fix the pellet with 500 μL ice-cold 70% ethanol.
Label this tube as time point 0.
Wash the alpha-factor arrested culture three times with 1 mL Milli-Q water.
Transfer the washed cell pellet to a microfuge tube and resuspend in 1 mL Milli-Q water.
Split the cell suspension equally (500 μL:500 μL) between two tubes.
Spin down the cells for a final time and decant the supernatant.
Resuspend each pellet and bring to a total of 5 mL in SC media containing 0.02% methyl cellulose with and without 30 μM Taxol.
Conduct the release at around 24°C by keeping the cultures on the bench.
Swirl the cultures by hand every ∼10 min for the entire assay to ensure cells remain suspended.
Take 500 μL of each culture at designated time points and place in appropriately labeled tubes prepared previously.
Quickly spin down cells (4,000 g for 30 s).
Rapidly fix cells according to downstream application requirements.
Add 1.5 μL alpha-factor after the 90-min time point to prevent post-anaphase cells from re-budding.
Stain cells with DAPI as per the protocol guidelines.

Score anaphase onset by the state of DAPI separation into categories: pre-anaphase (one DAPI focus, small or large budded), anaphase (two DAPI foci, large budded), or anaphase re-bud (one DAPI focus, schmooing).
Take images with 12 planes (∼0.5 μm separation) in the DAPI channel (excited at 387, emission at 447).
Observe cells using Differential Interference Contrast (DIC) or polarized/bright field transmitted light to ensure proper imaging of DAPI focus.
Score 150–200 cells for each time point.
Inoculate a 5 mL SC-MET media culture (MGY 1293).
Grow the culture at 30°C for 12–24 hours before using it to inoculate larger overnight cultures.
Use the freshly saturated 5 mL culture to inoculate into a 30-50 mL culture in SC-MET media at 30°C, aiming for an OD600 of 0.15-0.4 the next morning.
Pellet the cells by centrifugation (3,000 g for 3–5 min) once desired OD is reached.
Resuspend the pellet in 10 mL SC-MET media if collecting overnight culture for G1 synchronization.
Add 3.5 μL alpha-factor to arrest cells in G1.
Incubate and shake/rotate the cells at 230–250 rpm at 30°C for 3 hours.
Check under a light microscope to ensure >95% of cells are unbudded or schmooing.
Set up metaphase arrest cultures while cells are arresting in G1.
Make two identical tubes of metaphase-arrest media, each containing 970 μL.
Each tube contains: 860 μL SC-MET, 10 μL 2% methyl cellulose (1:100 dilution), and 100 μL 2 mg/mL methionine solution (1:10 dilution).
Spin down the alpha-factor arrested culture.
Transfer the pellet to a microfuge tube.
Wash the cells three times with 1 mL Milli-Q water.
Decant the supernatant from the second wash.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 1 mL.
Split the cell suspension equally (500 μL:500 μL) between two tubes.
Resuspend each pellet into the 970 μL metaphase-arrest media and incubate for 1.25–1.5 h on a rotator at 30°C to reach metaphase arrest.
Check cells on a light microscope to confirm synchronous budding and medium-budded state.
If not, continue incubating longer until the cells bud synchronously.
Add 30 μM Taxol final concentration (30 μL of 1 mM stock) to one tube and 30 μL DMSO to the control tube once cells appear medium to large budded.
Incubate on the bench for another 15 min, gently shaking/swirling by hand every few minutes.
Spin down cultures in a microfuge tube.
Wash cells three times with Milli-Q water quickly to minimize potential expulsion of Taxol and MTs.
Resuspend one of each genotype pellet in the 5 mL metaphase-release media containing Taxol, and the other pellet in control metaphase-release media.
Keep the two 5 mL release cultures on the bench at around 24°C.
Gently shake or swirl the cultures by hand every 10 minutes to ensure cells remain suspended.
Take 500 μL of each culture and place in appropriately labeled tubes at designated time points.
Quickly spin down the cells at 4,000 g for 30 seconds.
Rapidly fix the cells according to the downstream application (see Table 1).
Stain cells with DAPI (see Table 1).
Score anaphase onset by the state of DAPI separation into categories: unbudded cells, metaphase, and anaphase.
Take images with 12 planes at approximately 0.5 μm separation in the DAPI and DIC channels to ensure each DAPI spot can be scored as separated or connected.
If DIC is not available on your microscope, use polarized or bright field transmitted light for imaging.
Score approximately 150–200 cells for each time point.
Calculate the amount of YPD media needed for all plates.
Dissolve the corresponding amount of YPD media ingredients in half the final volume of Milli-Q water.
Add the corresponding amount of agar to the solution.
Add a stir bar to the bottle containing the solution and agar.
Autoclave.
Filter-sterilize the 2× YPD solution into the molten 2× agar using a 0.22 μm bottle-top filter.
Thoroughly mix the 2× YPD and 2× agar to create 1× final using the stir bar and stir plate.
Pour 35 mL into a 50 mL conical tube.
Add the corresponding amount of Taxol stock solution and DMSO before cooling.
Inoculate a 5 mL culture in YPD for strains MGY1872, MGY1874, and MGY2104.
Incubate on a rotator/shaker overnight at 30°C.
Use this culture to inoculate 10 μL into 10 mL fresh YPD the next day.
Incubate on a rotator/shaker at 30°C for the next 48–72 h.
Add 150–200 μL of each saturated culture to the top well in a 96-well plate.
Perform 10× serial dilutions to create the range of dilutions for plating.
Use a multichannel pipette with 2–3 μL of each 10× serial dilution to create each spot on the Taxol-containing plates.
Alternatively, use a multi-pinned spotter or ‘frogger’ to transfer droplets from the 96-well plate onto the various test plates.
Incubate spotted plates at 24°C and monitor for differences in Taxol sensitivity over the next 3–5 days.
Image the plates with an overhead bright light.
Record and analyze results.
